result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback by limiting any commitment to the current 12-month term, allowing reduction on 30 days’ notice, and eliminating a penalty or take-or-pay shortfall charge. The revisions are confined to the commitment mechanics and preserve the remaining commercial framework. Drafting is generally professional, although “a true-up of Fees for Services actually ordered” is somewhat unclear because fees for actual orders do not ordinarily constitute a shortfall true-up.
